# Spec: install-wizard
<!-- Generated by /hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-10-10 -->

## Overview

Installing or upgrading hefesto today means reading a ~350-line `docs/install.md`. A junior engineer
whose current setup is unknown cannot do that reliably, and the upgrade guide we wrote for one was
judged too complex.

This feature adds **one command** that runs an interactive installation wizard. It inspects the
machine, explains what it found, proposes each step with a recommended default, and then installs or
upgrades hefesto and verifies the result. It speaks English or Brazilian Portuguese.

```bash
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joaoariedi/hefesto/main/install.sh)
# or, from a clone:  bash ~/.claude-framework/install.sh
```

Decisions taken here:

- **One file, `install.sh`, at the repository root.** It is not plugin payload, so it lives beside
  `README.md`, not under `hooks/`.
- **Zero-install:** bash, git, jq, coreutils, and the `claude` CLI it configures (constitution 4).
  `gh` is checked and recommended, never required.
- **It never deletes.** Anything it removes from the profile (old commands, agents, hooks) is MOVED
  to `~/hefesto-old/<timestamp>/`.
- **It never runs with privilege:** no `sudo`, and it refuses to run as root.
- **It never force-pulls.** A clone with local changes or a diverged history stops the wizard with
  the reason. It never discards anything.
- **It runs in a normal terminal, never inside a Claude Code session's sandbox.** It writes
  `~/.claude*` and pulls from GitHub. When `$HOME` is not writable it says so and stops.
- **Profiles:** a profile is `~/.claude` plus every `~/.claude-*` directory that holds a
  `settings.json` or a `plugins/` directory. The clone (`~/.claude-framework`, which holds
  `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`) is never a profile.
- **Version:** by default the latest release tag (`v*`), which is the recommended choice;
  `main` is offered as the alternative.
- **Interaction:**
  - Questions are read from `/dev/tty`, so `bash <(curl …)` works.
  - Every question shows the recommended answer as the default (Enter accepts it).
  - `--yes` accepts every recommendation without asking.
  - `--dry-run` prints the plan and changes nothing.
- **Language:** messages in English, or Portuguese when `--lang pt` is given or `LANG` starts with
  `pt`.

## User Scenarios

### US1: A fresh machine [P1]
- **Given** git, jq and claude installed, and no clone or plugin
- **When** the engineer runs the wizard and presses Enter at every question
- **Then** it:
  - clones the repo to `~/.claude-framework` at the latest release tag;
  - adds the marketplace and installs `hefesto@hefesto` in every detected profile;
  - copies the rules, and copies `CLAUDE.md` after keeping the engineer's own copy as `CLAUDE.md.mine`;
  - prints a verification table (profile → installed version) and the next steps: restart,
    then check the `hefesto <v> hooks loaded from` line, then `/hef.doctor`.

### US2: An upgrade [P1]
- **Given** a clone at 7.8.x and `hefesto@hefesto` installed in two profiles
- **When** the wizard runs
- **Then** it:
  - reports "installed 7.8.x, latest 7.9.2";
  - updates the clone, refreshes the marketplace and updates the plugin in both profiles;
  - re-copies the rules;
  - shows every profile at 7.9.2.

### US3: A legacy setup [P1]
- **Given** the old plugin `ai-development-framework@ai-development-framework`, `speckit.*.md` /
  `hef.*.md` files in `~/.claude/commands`, or symlinks into a dotfiles folder
- **When** the wizard runs
- **Then** it lists each finding and recommends removing it:
  - it uninstalls the old plugin and removes its marketplace;
  - it moves the stray files to the backup folder;
  - for a stow install it prints the exact `stow -D` command and stops before installing (it does not
    run stow itself).

### US4: Safe by default [P1]
- **Given** a clone with uncommitted changes
- **When** the wizard reaches the update step
- **Then** it stops with the reason and leaves the clone untouched
- **Edge cases:**
  - `--dry-run` changes nothing: no clone, no plugin call, no file moved;
  - run as root → refused;
  - a missing required tool → it names it with an install hint and stops before changing anything.

### US5: Language and non-interactive use [P2]
- **Given** `LANG=pt_BR.UTF-8`
- **When** the wizard runs
- **Then** every message is in Portuguese
- **And** `--yes` runs the same plan with no questions; `--lang en` forces English.

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | Pre-flight: `git`, `jq`, `claude` required, `gh` recommended; refuse root; refuse when `$HOME` is not writable. A missing requirement prints a per-OS hint and exits 1 before any change | P1 | US4 |
| FR-002 | Detection reports:<br>- the clone: absent, or present with its remote, its version from `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, and whether it is dirty;<br>- each profile, by the FR rule above, with its installed hefesto version from `plugins/installed_plugins.json`;<br>- the legacy plugin, legacy command/agent/hook files, and stow symlinks;<br>- the latest release tag (`git ls-remote --tags`). | P1 | US1–US3 |
| FR-003 | The plan: an ordered list of the steps the wizard WILL take, each with its recommendation and why. Each step is a yes/no question, with the recommended answer as the default:<br>- back up each profile (`cp -a` to `~/.claude*.backup-<ts>`);<br>- remove the legacy items;<br>- clone or update the clone;<br>- the version (tag or main);<br>- the profiles to install into;<br>- copy the rules and `CLAUDE.md`. | P1 | US1–US3 |
| FR-004 | Execution:<br>- clone or update the clone; a dirty or diverged clone stops the wizard;<br>- `claude plugin marketplace add` / `update`, and `claude plugin install` / `update hefesto@hefesto`, with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` set per profile;<br>- moves, never deletes;<br>- each step's failure stops the wizard with its message. | P1 | US1, US2, US4 |
| FR-005 | Verification: a table of profile → hefesto version from the registry after the run, and the next steps. Exit 0 only when every chosen profile shows the target version | P1 | US1, US2 |
| FR-006 | Flags: `--yes`, `--dry-run`, `--lang en\|pt`, `--profile <dir>` (repeatable, overrides detection), `--version <tag\|main>`, `--help`. Test seams: `HEFESTO_REPO_URL` (the clone source) and `HEFESTO_CLONE_DIR` | P1 | US4, US5 |
| FR-007 | Bilingual messages (en, pt-BR) from one table; `LANG=pt*` selects Portuguese | P2 | US5 |
| FR-008 | Docs:<br>- README "Install" leads with the one command;<br>- `docs/install.md` §1 mentions the wizard;<br>- `SETUP.md` points at it;<br>- CHANGELOG. | P2 | all |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | Smoke fixture: a temp `HOME`, a local bare repo as `HEFESTO_REPO_URL` with tags v7.8.0 and v7.9.2, and a fake `claude` that records argv and writes `installed_plugins.json`. Cases:<br>- fresh `--yes` → clone at v7.9.2, install in 2 profiles, the clone not treated as a profile, rules copied, `CLAUDE.md.mine` kept;<br>- upgrade from v7.8.0 → `update` calls;<br>- legacy plugin and files → uninstall plus moves into `~/hefesto-old`, nothing deleted;<br>- a dirty clone → stop, untouched;<br>- `--dry-run` → no change at all;<br>- root refused; a missing jq refused;<br>- pt messages under `LANG=pt_BR.UTF-8`;<br>- scripted answers read from a fake tty (`HEFESTO_TTY`), so declining a step skips it. | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-002 | Mutations: dry-run writes; the clone counted as a profile; a delete instead of a move; the dirty-clone stop; the per-profile `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. Each turns the suite red | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-003 | A real run by the user on a machine (or the junior engineer's) | user-run |

## Clarifications
_None. A stow install is reported with the exact command, not unstowed automatically, because `stow -D` touches the user's dotfiles._
